subject: Mathematics
concept: Integers: Positive Numbers, Negative Numbers, and Zero
standard_explanation: Integers comprise the set of whole numbers and their negative counterparts: {..., -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, ...}. On a horizontal Cartesian number line, positive integers lie strictly to the right of the central origin zero, while negative integers lie to the left. The magnitude of a negative number increases as its numerical value becomes more negative, representing quantities below a defined baseline such as sub-zero temperatures, financial debt, or subterranean elevation.
simplified_explanation: Numbers can tell us if we are above or below ground! Imagine a tall building with a ground floor called 0. Going upstairs gives positive floors like +1, +2, +3. Going down to the basement parking gives negative floors like -1, -2, -3! Both sides balance evenly around 0!
key_points: Positive numbers (+1, +2, +3) are greater than zero and sit to the right on a number line.
Zero (0) is in the exact center and is neither positive nor negative.
Negative numbers (-1, -2, -3) are less than zero and sit to the left on a number line.
Moving right on the number line increases value; moving left decreases value.
-5 is smaller than -2 because it is further to the left from zero.
examples: Winter temperature at high mountains reaching -5 degrees Celsius is below freezing zero.
A submarine diving 50 meters below sea level is at an elevation of -50 meters.
misconceptions: Misconception: -10 is bigger than -2 because 10 is bigger than 2. Fact: -10 is much colder and smaller because it is further left of zero.
Misconception: Zero is a positive number. Fact: Zero is completely neutral: neither positive nor negative.

visual_scenes.title: Drawing the Horizontal Number Line
visual_scenes.description: A clean straight horizontal line drawn with tick marks, placing a shining number 0 right at the center origin.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 1: Here is a number line with neutral 0 sitting right in the center.

visual_scenes.title: Positive Numbers Marching to the Right
visual_scenes.description: Green numbers +1, +2, +3, +4 step forward toward the right into sunny warm territory.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 2: Numbers to the right are positive (+1, +2, +3) and get bigger as you go right.

visual_scenes.title: Negative Numbers Stepping Below Zero to the Left
visual_scenes.description: Icy blue numbers -1, -2, -3 step out to the left into cold sub-zero territory.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 3: Numbers to the left are negative (-1, -2, -3) and get smaller as you go left!

visual_scenes.title: Balanced Integer Continuum
visual_scenes.description: The complete number line in full perspective, glowing with positive warmth on the right and cool negative tones on the left.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 4: All together, positive numbers, zero, and negative numbers form the integers!

assessment_questions.concept: Integers: Positive Numbers, Negative Numbers, and Zero
assessment_questions.question: Which of these numbers is smaller: -5 or -1?
assessment_questions.hint: Remember: on the number line, numbers further to the left are smaller.
